tagline: The everyday stack for solo builders, side projects, and self-improvement
description: No API keys required (except optional Brave Search). Optimized for a single developer working across personal projects, research, and quick tasks. Light on tokens, high on utility.

tools.name: memory
tools.why: Claude remembers your projects, preferences, and context across every session

tools.name: filesystem
tools.why: Read, write, and organize local files without copy-pasting into the chat

tools.name: fetch
tools.why: Read any webpage as clean markdown — research, recipes, documentation, anything

tools.name: brave-search
tools.why: Real-time web search so Claude isn't limited to its training cutoff (free tier available)

tools.name: time
tools.why: Always accurate dates and timezone conversions for scheduling, journaling, and planning
